source.title: Banned and restricted herbal ingredients for medicinal use
source.publisher: UK Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA)
source.legal_instrument: The Medicines for Human Use (Kava-kava) (Prohibition) Order 2002, SI 2002/3170

claim_scope.regulated_object: medicine for human use containing the plant, any plant part, or an extract

evidence.short_exact_excerpt: Not permitted in unlicensed medicines, except those exclusively for external use
evidence.locator: MHRA banned/restricted herbal ingredients table, Piper methysticum / Kava-kava / SI 3170 row

limitations: The case is limited to UK medicinal-product regulation.
It does not assert a food, food-supplement, cosmetic, or global prohibition.
The external-use exception is preserved explicitly.
